description: Architecture-only paraphrase of NASA/CR-2019-220217 (June 2019), sections 1.3 and 5.1, printed pages 2 and 29–30. The concept combines a turboshaft-driven electrical generator, AC/DC conversion, a battery network, motor controllers, electric motors and mechanical rotor drive paths. Four rotor powertrains include clutches, gearboxes and interconnecting shafts. Flight control computers command motor controllers. Cooling fans, heat exchangers and lubrication pumps support the propulsion equipment. Batteries are charged before flight and may be recharged during the mission. Hover and cruise are in scope. This summary describes architecture and intended functions only; it includes no FMECA mode/cause/effect rows, reference ratings, benchmark matches, failure rates or criticality numbers. Engineering detail omitted by the summary must remain unknown. Source: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20190026443 .
